subject: Opslice demo: aligning SE + customer eng windows (timezones & procurement)
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@opslice.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-09T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + SE demo — suggested windows (PT/ET)

Hi Samira — great talking yesterday. As discussed, we'd like to get a 60–75 minute technical walkthrough with one of our Solutions Engineers to cover:

- architecture fit: VPC + private deployment options
- latency/cost expectations for your 2M requests/mo workload
- security and audit log patterns for compliance

Priyom (cc) would lead the demo. To avoid back-and-forth across timezones, propose the following windows (pick one):

Option A — Tue May 11 9:00–10:15 PT / 12:00–13:15 ET
Option B — Tue May 11 13:30–14:45 PT / 16:30–17:45 ET
Option C — Wed May 12 8:00–9:15 PT / 11:00–12:15 ET

If procurement needs to join for a short pricing/contract call, we can either include them for the first 10 minutes or schedule a quick follow-up. I attached the latest MAP and a SE demo checklist for your team.

Thanks — LMK which works and whether you need any security pre-read.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 415‑555‑0192
From: Samira Khan <samira@opslice.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dylan Reed <dylan.reed@opslice.com>, Opslice Procurement <procurement@opslice.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-09T18:04:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Intro + SE demo — suggested windows (PT/ET)

Thanks Vanessa — and thanks for the options. A few notes:

- Our lead infra engineer (Dylan) needs to be on the call for the VPC discussion. He has partial availability Tue afternoon (ET) but fully available Wed morning ET.
- Procurement would prefer to join only the pricing segment; they may be available Wed 12:30–13:00 ET.
- Security wants a short list of what logs/data the demo will touch and whether any customer data will be uploaded during the walkthrough.

Can we aim for Wed May 12 11:00–12:15 ET (Option C mapped to ET)? That matches Dylan and gives procurement time for a separate 30‑minute follow-up. If that works, can Priyom confirm any special access Dylan should prepare (temporary keys, corp network whitelist)?

— Samira
Senior Product Ops, Opslice
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@opslice.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-10T08:09:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + SE demo — suggested windows (PT/ET)

Hi Samira — Wed May 12 11:00–12:15 ET works for me and Priyom here (I've blocked it tentatively). A couple of prep items from the SE side: 

- For the VPC/private deployment walkthrough we typically ask for either:
  * a short read-only IAM key so we can show a sample config, or
  * a local config file (sanitized) that represents your runtime traffic profile.
- We will not request or store any customer PII during the demo — we'll use synthetic data for live queries.
- Can Dylan share the CIDR ranges that the engineering team would allow for a temporary demo connection? A quick Slack DM or a calendar note is fine.

I'll prepare a short demo script and share a Drive link to the materials (screenshots + sequence). Marcus — would you like to run the initial 5–10 minute intro and procurement handoff?

Thanks,
— Priyom
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai
From: Opslice Procurement <procurement@opslice.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Samira Khan <samira@opslice.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-10T11:05:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Intro + SE demo — suggested windows (PT/ET)

Hi team — procurement can do a 30‑minute sync Wed May 12 at 12:30–13:00 ET to cover pricing and contract timeline.

Action items for procurement before the call:
- Please send any current SOW/contract draft (we'll want to see terms re: data retention and indemnity)
- Provide the expected PO process and lead times

We received the MAP PDF — thanks.

Regards,
Opslice Procurement
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@opslice.com>, Dylan Reed <dylan.reed@opslice.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-11T18:04:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Intro + SE demo — aligning SE + customer eng windows (timezones & procurement)

Thanks all — confirming the plan and a couple of clarifications before we lock the calendar: 

- Final schedule: Wed May 12, 11:00–12:15 ET (SE demo; Priyom lead).
- Procurement quick sync: Wed May 12, 12:30–13:00 ET (Vanessa to host).
- Dylan: for the VPC segment we only need the CIDR allowlist and a test endpoint (no credentials stored). If you can paste the CIDR ranges into the calendar invite or Slack DM, SE will use that for a short live connection demonstration.
- Security pre-read: Priyom will attach a 1‑page note on what the demo touches (logs, telemetry) — no customer data will be used.

I've created a provisional calendar invite (see link). Priyom — attaching the SE-demo-checklist and Opslice-MAP-v2 here so procurement and security have the artifacts.

If anyone needs a different timezone mapping (APAC participants), flag it and we can offer a recorded run or an additional slot. 

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Partner, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai | +1 617‑555‑0183

Attachments:
- Opslice-MAP-v2.pdf (att): account plan and key contacts
- SE-demo-checklist.docx (att): run order and necessary engineer prep
